summary: Jade Biosciences filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose preclinical data for JADE301, its anti-interferon beta monoclonal antibody candidate for dermatomyositis. The filing reports binding affinity (KD 11.3 pM, ~2.5x versus a dazukibart comparator), potency in signaling and MX-1 assays, an approximately 30-day half-life in non-human primates, predicted human subcutaneous bioavailability of ~73%-75%, and favorable GLP toxicology tolerability. Jade plans a 24-participant single ascending-dose Phase 1 trial. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or closing terms are involved; this is ordinary clinical pipeline disclosure, not a special situation.
